mapper.select: /* selectMasterMdPpPropDetailPop */ SELECT PP_NO, PP_REQ_USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_req_user_id}) AS REQ_USER_NAME, PP_SUBJECT, PP_REMARK, DECODE(STATUS, 'G', '제안요청', 'P', '제안평가', 'C', '등급확정', 'D', '삭제', 'R', '불채택') AS STATUS, TO_CHAR(ADD_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS ADD_DATE, PP_REQ_ATTKEY FROM KEPAPPHD WHERE PP_NO = #{st_pp_no}

/* selectMasterMdPpPropArpsPop */ SELECT DT.PP_ARPS_ID, NVL(U.USER_NAME_LOC, '') AS PP_ARPS_NAME, NVL(U.DEPARTMENT, '') AS DEPARTMENT, (SELECT NVL(TEXT1, '') FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = U.COM_CODE AND CODE = U.DEPARTMENT AND FLAG = 'Y') AS PP_ARPS_DEPT, DT.PP_ATTB1, DT.PP_ATTB2, DT.PP_ATTB3, DT.PP_ATTB4, DT.PP_ATTB5, DECODE(DT.STATUS, 'P', TO_CHAR(DT.CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI'), '') AS CHANGE_DATE, DT.PP_EXC_DEPT FROM KEPAPPDT DT , ICOMLUSR U WHERE 1=1 AND DT.PP_ARPS_ID = U.USER_ID(+) AND DT.PP_NO = #{st_pp_no} AND DT.PP_SEQ = #{st_pp_seq}
mapper.update: /* saveMasterMdPpPropArps */ UPDATE KEPAPPDT SET STATUS = 'P', PP_ATTB1 = #{pp_attb1}, PP_ATTB_P1 = #{pp_attb_p1}, PP_ATTB2 = #{pp_attb2}, PP_ATTB_P2 = #{pp_attb_p2}, PP_ATTB3 = #{pp_attb3}, PP_ATTB_P3 = #{pp_attb_p3}, PP_ARPS_ID = #{user_id}, PP_EXC_DEPT = #{exec_team}, CHANGE_DATE = SYSDATE, CHANGE_USER_ID = #{user_id} WHERE PP_NO = #{pp_no} AND PP_SEQ = #{pp_seq}

/* rejectMasterMdPpPropArps */ UPDATE KEPAPPDT SET STATUS = 'R', PP_ATTB1 = '', PP_ATTB_P1 = 0, PP_ATTB2 = '', PP_ATTB_P2 = 0, PP_ATTB3 = '', PP_ATTB_P3 = 0, PP_ARPS_ID = #{user_id}, PP_R_REMARK = #{reason}, CHANGE_DATE = SYSDATE, CHANGE_USER_ID = #{user_id} WHERE PP_NO = #{pp_no} AND PP_SEQ = #{pp_seq}
